name: Bonyuu Nurse Nakadashi Tengoku! 2
original_name: 母乳ナース 中出し天国！2
source:
Boring life.... Nothing Special.... But one day, there is a girl in a nurse uniform in front of the main character when he wakes up! "Oh, good morning!!" What would you do if there was a pretty nurse when you woke up...?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
乏味的生活…没有任何特别之处…可某天，主人公醒来时，面前竟站着一个身穿护士服的女孩！"哦，早上好！！"如果你一睁眼就看见一位漂亮护士，会怎么做呢…？

[摘自ErogeShop]
